verdict.rationale: Spline is a 3D/2D design tool with no concept of production vs sandbox data environments — its 'sandboxing' evidence (spline-docs-11/24) refers to an isolated iframe for embedded HTML code, not a staging/production data separation for AI-native testing. This story presumes a data-driven platform with prod/sandbox environments, which is not how Spline's editor/export model works, making the axis inapplicable.
